sentences.en: Psychotherapy is a personal process for many people.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，心理治疗是一个非常私人的过程。

sentences.en: What works for me may not work for you.
sentences.zh: 对我有效的方法，对你未必有效。

sentences.en: But in other health care settings, there is research that has offered some guidance to people looking for the right therapist and the right treatment.
sentences.zh: 但在其他医疗保健领域，已有研究为那些寻找合适治疗师和合适疗法的人提供了一些指导。

sentences.en: In this episode, we talk with psychologist and researcher Bruce Wampold about how to make psychotherapy effective and long-lasting.
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我们采访了心理学家兼研究员布鲁斯·万波尔德（Bruce Wampold），探讨如何让心理治疗变得有效且持久。

sentences.en: I'm Audrey Hamilton, and this is Speaking of Psychology.
sentences.zh: 我是奥黛丽·汉密尔顿（Audrey Hamilton），这里是《心理学谈话》（Speaking of Psychology）。

sentences.en: Bruce Wampold is the Patricia L.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯·万波尔德是帕特里夏·L·沃尔特（Patricia L. Walit）教授，

sentences.en: Walit Professor of Counseling Psychology at the University of Wisconsin-Madison.
sentences.zh: 在威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校担任咨询心理学教授。

sentences.en: He's also director of the Research Institute at Modembad Psychiatric Center in Norway.
sentences.zh: 他同时也是挪威莫登巴德（Modembad）精神病学中心研究所的所长。

sentences.en: He served on the American Psychological Association's Presidential Task Force on Evidence-Based Practice in Psychology,
sentences.zh: 他曾在美国心理学会（APA）的循证心理实践总统特别工作组任职，

sentences.en: and his research on psychotherapy and methodology has been published in several APA journals,
sentences.zh: 他关于心理治疗和方法论的研究已在多家APA期刊上发表，

sentences.en: including Psychological Bulletin, American Psychologist, and the Journal of Consulting and Clinical Psychology.
sentences.zh: 包括《心理学公报》、《美国心理学家》以及《咨询与临床心理学杂志》。

sentences.en: He is author of the book, The Great Psychotherapy Debate, which is a synthesis of empirical research on psychotherapy
sentences.zh: 他著有《伟大的心理治疗辩论》（The Great Psychotherapy Debate）一书，该书综合了心理治疗的实证研究，

sentences.en: and provides a model for understanding how psychotherapy works.
sentences.zh: 并为理解心理治疗的运作机制提供了一个模型。

sentences.en: Welcome, Dr. Wampold.
sentences.zh: 欢迎您，万波尔德博士。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Psychotherapy is tremendously effective for many people, but is it correct to say that psychotherapy works differently for different people?
sentences.zh: 心理治疗对许多人来说非常有效，但说心理治疗对不同的人有不同的效果，这种说法准确吗？

sentences.en: Well, there's many approaches to psychotherapy, and many people come with different kinds of problems, different styles.
sentences.zh: 嗯，心理治疗有很多种方法，而且许多人带着各种不同的问题和不同的风格而来。

sentences.en: So, yes, it does work differently for different people, but in the core, it's probably more similar than it is different.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，它对不同的人确实有不同的效果，但从核心来看，它可能更多是相似而非不同。

sentences.en: So, if I were a client seeking therapy, how would I know I'm getting the best treatment?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果我是一个寻求治疗的客户，我怎么知道我得到的是最好的治疗呢？

sentences.en: And like you said, I know we're all different, and we all have our different issues, but there's got to be a way to determine what's working for you.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，我知道我们每个人都不同，都有各自的问题，但一定有一种方法可以确定什么对你有效。

sentences.en: Well, psychotherapy is a very personal process.
sentences.zh: 嗯，心理治疗是一个非常私人的过程。

sentences.en: You have a therapist and delivering a particular kind of treatment.
sentences.zh: 你有一位治疗师，并且在进行某种特定的治疗。

sentences.en: The most important thing is that you have faith in the therapist and the treatment method the therapist is using with you.
sentences.zh: 最重要的事情是你对治疗师以及治疗师所采用的治疗方法有信心。

sentences.en: And this is something you should discuss with your therapiSt.
sentences.zh: 这是你应该与你的治疗师讨论的事情。

sentences.en: So, if you feel like you're not making progress, and most patients make relatively significant progress in the first five or six sessions,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你觉得没有取得进展——大多数患者在前五到六次治疗中会取得相对显著的进展——

sentences.en: then you should discuss that with your therapist and discuss the progress you're making and how therapy is progressing.
sentences.zh: 那么你应该与你的治疗师讨论这个问题，探讨你所取得的进展以及治疗的进展情况。

sentences.en: So, what you're saying, every therapist is different and has their own style,
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，每位治疗师都不同，都有自己的风格，

sentences.en: but what qualities do all effective therapists have, and how can a patient select some of those qualities to treat their specific issues?
sentences.zh: 但所有有效的治疗师具备哪些共同品质？患者又该如何选择这些品质来治疗他们特定的问题呢？

sentences.en: Well, it's true.
sentences.zh: 嗯，确实如此。

sentences.en: Therapists have a lot of different styles, and there are successful therapists who are very different than others who are also successful.
sentences.zh: 治疗师有许多不同的风格，成功的治疗师之间可能大相径庭，但他们同样成功。

sentences.en: But there is a common core we know now of characteristics and actions of effective therapists.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在知道，有效的治疗师在特征和行为上有一个共同的核心。

sentences.en: So, effective therapists have a very sophisticated set of interpersonal skills that are focused on helping the patient.
sentences.zh: 有效的治疗师拥有一套非常成熟的人际交往技巧，专注于帮助患者。

sentences.en: Successful therapists or effective therapists are able to form a working relationship with a variety of patients.
sentences.zh: 成功的或有效的治疗师能够与各种各样的患者建立工作关系。

sentences.en: And effective therapists seem to be those who are reflective and practice deliberately to get better.
sentences.zh: 而且有效的治疗师似乎都是那些善于反思并刻意练习以求进步的人。

sentences.en: So, for the patient, it's really difficult to assess whether the therapist has these qualities.
sentences.zh: 所以，对于患者来说，评估治疗师是否具备这些品质确实很难。

sentences.en: But again, this is something that should be discussed with the therapist in terms of, do you feel like you're making adequate progress in the therapeutic endeavor?
sentences.zh: 但同样，这应该与治疗师进行讨论，比如：你是否觉得在治疗过程中取得了足够的进展？

sentences.en: How long should that progress take?
sentences.zh: 这种进展需要多长时间？

sentences.en: Are we talking weeks, months, years?
sentences.zh: 我们是指几周、几个月还是几年？

sentences.en: Well, it really depends on the problem people bring.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这确实取决于人们带来的问题。

sentences.en: Many problems that people bring to therapy are really amenable to a treatment of 5 or 6 or 10 sessions.
sentences.zh: 人们带到治疗中的许多问题，其实通过5、6次或10次治疗就能得到改善。

sentences.en: It makes significant progress.
sentences.zh: 它能带来显著的进展。

sentences.en: Therapy is something that you don't just do once in life and you're cured.
sentences.zh: 治疗不是你一生中只做一次就能治愈的事情。

sentences.en: You might feel quite satisfied for several years.
sentences.zh: 你可能会感到几年都很满意。

sentences.en: And then there's another stressor in your life or something happens and you want to go back.
sentences.zh: 然后生活中又出现了压力源或发生了什么事，你想回去（继续治疗）。

sentences.en: And that's perfectly ordinarily.
sentences.zh: 这完全是很正常的。

sentences.en: There are some disorders, severe disorders, in which it's more like a chronic disease like diabetes.
sentences.zh: 有些疾病，严重的疾病，更像是糖尿病那样的慢性病。

sentences.en: And you might require more intensive care for longer periods of time.
sentences.zh: 你可能需要更长时间的强化护理。

sentences.en: Is this something you should be discussing with your therapist at the start of your treatment?
sentences.zh: 这是你应该在治疗开始时就与治疗师讨论的事情吗？

sentences.en: How long should you be going before you see some benefits?
sentences.zh: 在看到一些效果之前，你应该坚持多久？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: This is something the therapist should assess and discuss with you.
sentences.zh: 这是治疗师应该评估并与你讨论的事情。

sentences.en: And you should get an idea about what is the conditions of the therapy, both in terms of its length,
sentences.zh: 你应该对治疗的条件有一个概念，包括治疗的时长，

sentences.en: but the activities you're going to do, your prognosis, and these kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 以及你将要进行的活动、你的预后等等这些事情。

sentences.en: We know now that therapy can be as effective as medication for some of these disorders.
sentences.zh: 我们现在知道，对于其中一些疾病，心理治疗可以和药物治疗一样有效。

sentences.en: You know, clinical trials have been done on this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这方面已经进行过临床试验。

sentences.en: Yet many doctors prescribe psychotropic medications without even recommending therapy.
sentences.zh: 然而，许多医生在甚至不推荐心理治疗的情况下就开具了精神类药物。

sentences.en: Why is that?
sentences.zh: 这是为什么？

sentences.en: You know, when are medications appropriate?
sentences.zh: 你知道，药物在什么时候是合适的？

sentences.en: Well, this is a complex question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个复杂的问题。

sentences.en: I can say, you know, that every clinician practices within their discipline.
sentences.zh: 我可以这样说，每位临床医生都是在他们各自的学科范围内执业的。

sentences.en: So physicians are medical doctors, so the first thing they think of is prescribing a medication.
sentences.zh: 所以医生是医学博士，他们首先想到的是开药。

sentences.en: So it's not surprising that that would be frequently used.
sentences.zh: 所以药物被频繁使用也就不足为奇了。

sentences.en: But we do know, as you mentioned, that psychotherapy is as effective as medications for many of the disorders, mental disorders.
sentences.zh: 但正如你提到的，我们确实知道，对于许多精神障碍，心理治疗与药物治疗一样有效。

sentences.en: And it's more enduring.
sentences.zh: 而且它更持久。

sentences.en: So when you discontinue medication, some of which have some pretty significant side effects, people relapse.
sentences.zh: 当你停止服药时——其中一些药物有相当严重的副作用——人们会复发。

sentences.en: Whereas with psychotherapy, you learn some skills and ways to overcome or accept your difficulties that are longer lasting.
sentences.zh: 而通过心理治疗，你学会了一些技能和方法来克服或接受你的困难，这些效果更持久。

sentences.en: Do you find that more people are looking towards psychotherapy because of this very reason, like you mentioned, the side effects, et cetera,
sentences.zh: 你是否发现更多人因为这个原因——正如你提到的副作用等等——而倾向于心理治疗，

sentences.en: and the fact that they're being able to do it more naturally?
sentences.zh: 以及他们能够更自然地进行治疗这一事实？

sentences.en: Well, I think there's a lot of people who really naturally believe in psychotherapy, and that would be their first choice.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为有很多人确实从内心相信心理治疗，这会是他们的首选。

sentences.en: There's others who are skeptical of psychotherapy and maybe would benefit from other practices, although psychotherapists are really good at working with people,
sentences.zh: 也有其他人对心理治疗持怀疑态度，也许从其他实践中获益更多，尽管心理治疗师在与人合作方面真的很擅长，

sentences.en: even if they're resistant.
sentences.zh: 即使他们有抵触情绪。

sentences.en: So I wouldn't say if you don't believe in psychotherapy, it's not going to be helpful.
sentences.zh: 所以我不会说如果你不相信心理治疗，它就不会有帮助。

sentences.en: That's not really true.
sentences.zh: 那其实不是真的。

sentences.en: But again, so much of it is determined by the person who's treating you.
sentences.zh: 但同样，很大程度上这取决于治疗你的人。

sentences.en: So if you talk about your depression or anxiety with a physician, you're more likely to get medication.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你和医生谈论你的抑郁或焦虑，你更有可能得到药物。

sentences.en: That's kind of a natural consequence, although there's many physicians who recognize the importance of psychotherapy.
sentences.zh: 这是一种自然的结果，尽管许多医生也认识到心理治疗的重要性。

sentences.en: There are some situations where medication and therapy can work together?
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，药物和治疗可以结合使用吗？

sentences.en: There's some research to indicate that the combination is beneficial.
sentences.zh: 有一些研究表明这种结合是有益的。

sentences.en: But again, it's a case-by-case basis.
sentences.zh: 但同样，这是因人而异的。

sentences.en: And the advantage of dual care, like medication and psychotherapy, over psychotherapy by itself is small.
sentences.zh: 而且双重护理（如药物加心理治疗）相对于单纯心理治疗的优势是很小的。

sentences.en: There is a lot of research out there on different kinds of psychotherapies, not just necessarily the therapist, but the therapies themselves,
sentences.zh: 关于不同种类的心理治疗，有很多研究，不仅仅是关于治疗师，还有治疗方法本身，

sentences.en: some of which you published and studied.
sentences.zh: 其中一些是你发表和研究过的。

sentences.en: Can we say what makes one type of therapy more effective than another?
sentences.zh: 我们能说是什么让一种疗法比另一种更有效吗？

sentences.en: Well, the research literature really indicates that there isn't one treatment, one kind of psychotherapy that's demonstrably better than any other.
sentences.zh: 嗯，研究文献确实表明，没有哪一种治疗、哪一种心理治疗被证明明显优于其他任何一种。

sentences.en: So they all work differently.
sentences.zh: 所以它们的作用方式各不相同。

sentences.en: The activities that are involved in the treatments are different.
sentences.zh: 治疗中涉及的活动是不同的。

sentences.en: And what seems to be important is that the patient believes and has faith in this particular method, what works best for them.
sentences.zh: 重要的是患者相信并对这种特定的方法有信心，即什么对他们最有效。

sentences.en: Some people want a more concrete, structured treatment, like cognitive behavioral therapy.
sentences.zh: 有些人想要更具体、结构化的治疗，比如认知行为疗法。

sentences.en: Other people find more exploratory and interpretive treatments, like dynamic treatments, more acceptable.
sentences.zh: 另一些人觉得探索性和解释性的治疗，比如动力学治疗，更容易接受。

sentences.en: So there's a variety of treatments, there's a variety of people, and it's important to find one that seems to fit for you and works.
sentences.zh: 所以治疗方法多种多样，人也多种多样，找到一种看起来适合你且有效的方法很重要。

sentences.en: Where do people research this type of therapy?
sentences.zh: 人们在哪里研究这种类型的治疗？

sentences.en: I mean, if I'm not sure what I would fit best with, how do people kind of look into the types of therapies that are out there?
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果我不确定什么最适合我，人们怎么去了解现有的治疗类型呢？

sentences.en: Well, that's a difficult thing to do because some therapists will advertise this is the kind of therapy I do.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一件很难做到的事情，因为有些治疗师会宣传这是我做的治疗类型。

sentences.en: Some therapists will wait until they understand the patient's problems and the context before they decide how they're going to work together.
sentences.zh: 有些治疗师会等到了解患者的问题和背景后，再决定如何共同工作。

sentences.en: But it's really difficult for somebody in the public to say, well, you know, I want brand X.
sentences.zh: 但对于公众来说，说“好吧，我知道了，我想要X品牌”，这真的很难。

sentences.en: Although, you know, if you want cognitive behavioral therapy, there's organizations which will refer you to cognitive behavioral therapists,
sentences.zh: 虽然，如果你想要认知行为疗法，有一些组织会把你推荐给认知行为治疗师，

sentences.en: same with dynamic therapists and so forth.
sentences.zh: 动力学治疗师等等也是如此。

sentences.en: So that is possible.
sentences.zh: 所以这是可能的。

sentences.en: But again, what I advise people to do is to go to a therapist who is recommended to them and see if this fits, see how it works.
sentences.zh: 但同样，我建议人们去找一位被推荐给他们的治疗师，看看是否合适，看看效果如何。

sentences.en: Much like a medical doctor, you know, you kind of don't know until you get in their room and see what their person is.
sentences.zh: 就像看医生一样，你知道，在走进他们的诊室看到他们本人之前，你是不知道的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what's really interesting is that somebody might recommend therapist X because they had a really good experience.
sentences.zh: 非常有趣的是，有人可能会推荐X治疗师，因为他们有非常好的体验。

sentences.en: And you might not find that style compatible with you at all.
sentences.zh: 而你可能根本觉得那种风格与你不兼容。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Well, thank you, Dr. Wampold, so much for joining us today.
sentences.zh: 嗯，非常感谢万波尔德博士今天加入我们。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Thanks very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: You can find more information on psychotherapy effectiveness on our website, speakingofpsychology.org.
sentences.zh: 你可以在我们的网站 speakingofpsychology.org 上找到更多关于心理治疗有效性的信息。

sentences.en: With the American Psychological Association, speaking of psychology, I'm Audrey Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 这里是美国心理学会的《心理学谈话》，我是奥黛丽·汉密尔顿。

sentences.en: I'm Audrey Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 我是奥黛丽·汉密尔顿。
